meaning:
σύμ-μορφος, -ον
(σύν, μορφή),
1. absol., similar (Luc.).
2. con­formed to: with dative, Php.3:21; with genitive, Rom.8:29 (see B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things…
